visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three individuals are positioned in a cozy living room. A woman in white overalls kneels on the floor, her hands gesturing excitedly while introducing a game. A man in a black t-shirt and a woman in a black dress sit on a grey sofa behind a small wooden table. The lighting is bright and warm, illuminating white walls and grey curtains. Yellow text [玩遊戲] appears at the bottom. (2) The group initiates a rapid object-passing game. The woman in white hands a small black remote to the man, who quickly passes it to the other woman. Faces show intense concentration with squinted eyes and open mouths as they speak quickly. A white spray bottle is soon introduced into the rotation. Rapid [Subtitle] text appears continuously at the bottom of the frame. (3) The intensity rises as the woman in white hoists a large black suitcase onto the circular wooden table. The participants reach out with frantic hand movements to touch and pass the multiple objects. The background remains the same indoor setting. Large variety-show style text like [超級大聲] and [第一輪] flashes on screen to mark the game's phases. (4) The game concludes with everyone breaking into hysterical laughter. The man bows his head over the suitcase, while both women smile widely and laugh. The woman in white overalls looks directly at the camera and claps her hands rhythmically. Subtitles like [笑成一片] appear, and the lighting remains bright as the scene ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice speaks with rapid speed and an animated tone to introduce the game. A cheerful 120 BPM acoustic guitar track plays in the background, providing a rhythmic bed. Room tone is quiet and studio-like with no noticeable ambient noise. (2) Three voices engage in extremely high-density, overlapping dialogue. The pitch variability is high as they bark short questions and answers at one another. The acoustic music continues steadily, synchronized with the rapid vocal cadence. Occasional light rustling sounds are heard as objects change hands. (3) A distinct percussive thud SFX marks the moment a heavy suitcase hits the wooden table. Vocals escalate into loud, high-arousal shouting and bursts of genuine laughter. The music stays consistent while comical 'ding' sound effects are inserted at key game interactions. (4) The track reaches a climax of group laughter and cheering, which has a very positive emotional valence. A loud applause SFX and a humorous laugh-track layer are added. A final female narration concludes the audio with a warm, friendly tone as the music slowly fades out.
